full_prompt_en: A square mixed-media collage presents a close-up black-and-white face against a dense wall of weathered posters and painted paper. The face occupies the center and most of the frame, looking forward with dark eyes, a straight nose, and softly closed lips. The forehead and hair meet large, cropped black letterforms across the upper edge, while a small red printed patch sits above the right eyebrow. At the upper left, an opaque acid-yellow rectangle interrupts the grayscale photograph and partly covers the surrounding hair. To the upper right, torn turquoise and yellow sheets gather behind the ear, their hard vertical edges contrasting with the rounded cheek and jaw. The left side of the face falls into heavy black shadow, but the eye remains visible within it; on the right, pale gray halftone and rubbed paper marks break the cheek into uneven planes. Short yellow and red fragments cross the left cheek, and a mustard-yellow pasted strip masks part of the right ear. The mouth and chin remain comparatively clear, anchoring the image beneath the restless collage. Below, a light striped shirt collar and dark outer garment emerge from shadow, with the lower edge cropping the body tightly. Around the shoulders, torn scraps expose old print, stains, scratches, and irregular glue-like seams rather than a smooth photographic backdrop. Hot red and pink blocks punctuate the lower left and upper right, while cool cyan recurs at the right edge and in small marks over the face. The image has the contrast of a flash-lit or strongly exposed monochrome photograph, yet the layered papers cast little spatial shadow; their visual force comes from abrupt changes of value and color. Small printed characters are partly visible in the collage, but most are cut off or too distressed to read reliably. Fine grain softens the photograph, while ragged paper boundaries, overprinting, and rubbed ink give the surface a tactile, repeatedly altered appearance. The overall composition is frontal and compressed, balancing a steady photographic gaze against noisy asymmetrical bursts of saturated color and distressed typography.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形混合媒介拼贴呈现一张黑白面部特写，背景是铺满磨旧海报和上色纸片的墙面。面部占据画面中央及大部分面积，深色眼睛直视前方，鼻梁笔直，双唇轻轻闭合。额头与头发和上缘被裁切的大幅黑色字形相接，右眉上方有一小块红色印刷贴片。左上角一块不透明的亮黄色矩形打断灰阶照片，也遮住周围部分头发。右上方，撕裂的青绿与黄色纸片聚在耳后，硬朗的竖直边缘与圆润的脸颊和下颌形成对照。脸的左侧沉入厚重黑影，但其中的眼睛依然可见；右侧则有浅灰网点和擦磨过的纸痕，把脸颊分解成不规则的色面。短小的黄红碎片穿过左脸颊，一条芥黄色拼贴遮住右耳的一部分。嘴部与下巴相对清楚，在躁动的拼贴下方稳定住画面。下部，浅色条纹衬衫领口和深色外衣从暗影中浮现，身体被下缘紧密裁去。肩膀周围，撕开的碎纸露出旧印刷、污渍、划痕和不规则的似胶缝隙，并非平滑的摄影背景。鲜红与亮粉色块点在左下和右上，冷青色则在右边缘及面部的小痕迹中重复。图像具有强曝光黑白照片般的对比度，但层叠纸片几乎不投下空间阴影；视觉力量来自明度与颜色的骤然切换。拼贴中局部可见细小印刷字符，但多数被裁断或磨损得无法可靠辨读。细颗粒使照片稍显柔和，毛糙纸边、套印和擦损的油墨则令表面带有反复改动的触感。整体构图正面而压缩，以稳定的摄影凝视平衡不对称的饱和色爆发与磨损字形造成的喧闹感。
style_prompt_en: Mixed-media photographic collage combines high-contrast grayscale imaging with torn, overprinted paper and abrupt fields of saturated pigment. Large dark values establish a stable core, while small electric yellow, hot pink, red, and cyan fragments interrupt it at irregular intervals. Photographic tonal modeling remains visible beneath opaque rectangles, translucent stains, rough halftone, and scraped ink, creating a productive tension between rounded volume and flat pasted planes. Edges alternate between clean typographic cuts, ragged tears, and rubbed transitions; some layers abruptly mask what lies below, while others allow traces to show through. The light reads as strong exposure in the underlying image, with deep shadow and pale highlights, whereas the surface additions work mainly through graphic contrast rather than realistic cast shadows. Cropped letterforms and partial print become abstract rhythm without requiring legible words. Dense overlapping marks collect around a clearer focal area, and asymmetrical color accents keep the compressed frame restless. The overall effect is tactile, urban, and charged, with damage and overprinting treated as essential visual structure.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介摄影拼贴把高对比灰阶影像与撕开的套印纸张、突兀的饱和颜料色块结合起来。大片深色明度建立稳定核心，电光黄、亮粉、红和青色的小碎片则以不规则间距打断它。摄影式的明暗塑形仍可从不透明矩形、半透明污渍、粗糙网点与刮擦油墨下面看见，使圆润体积与平坦拼贴色面形成张力。边缘在干净的字形切口、毛糙撕边与擦磨过渡间变换；有的层次突然遮住下方，有的则让痕迹透出。底层影像的光感像强曝光，带深影和浅亮部，而表面附加层主要靠图形对比而非写实投影发挥作用。被裁切的字形和残缺印刷成为抽象节奏，不要求词语可辨。密集的重叠痕迹聚在较清楚的焦点周围，不对称色彩重音让压缩画面始终躁动。整体效果有触感、都市感和冲击力，磨损与套印成为关键视觉结构。
theme_en: A close-up black-and-white face layered with torn neon posters
theme_zh: 一张黑白面部特写与撕裂的霓虹色海报层叠
name: DAIN
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
